set system host-name NATA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.10.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-0/0/0.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Bits of IPv4 subnet mask.

set security zones security-zone trust i.template: set security zones security-zone [parameter1] interfaces [parameter2] host-inbound-traffic system-services [parameter3]
set security zones security-zone trust i.command: set security zones security-zone trust interfaces ge-0/0/0 host-inbound-traffic system-services all
set security zones security-zone trust i.explanation: The interfaces with the secure Zone of Confidence allow all system service entry traffic.

parameters.name: security-zone
parameters.explanation: Name of safe area, such as trust.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-0/0/0.

parameters.name: system-services
parameters.explanation: Allowed type of system service, e.g. all.

set security zones security-zone untrust.template: set security zones security-zone [parameter1] interfaces [parameter2] host-inbound-traffic system-services [parameter3]
set security zones security-zone untrust.command: set security zones security-zone untrust interfaces ge-0/0/1 host-inbound-traffic system-services all
set security zones security-zone untrust.explanation: The interface with the untrusted area of the security area allows all system service entry traffic.

parameters.name: security-zone
parameters.explanation: Name of safe area, e.g. untrust.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-0/0/1.

parameters.name: system-services
parameters.explanation: Allowed type of system service, e.g. all.

set security nat source pool address-gro.template: set security nat source pool [parameter1] address [parameter2] to [parameter3]
set security nat source pool address-gro.command: set security nat source pool address-group1 address 11.11.11.101 to 11.11.11.105
set security nat source pool address-gro.explanation: Configure the address range of the source NAT address pool.

parameters.name: pool
parameters.explanation: Address pool name, e.g., address-group1.

parameters.name: start-address
parameters.explanation: Address pool start address.

parameters.name: end-address
parameters.explanation: Address pool end address.

set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] from zone [parameter2]
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.command: set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUND from zone trust
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.explanation: Configure the application area for the source NAT ruleset.

parameters.name: rule-set
parameters.explanation: Set of rules names, e.g. OUTBOUND.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.explanation: Source area name, such as trust.

set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] to zone [parameter2]
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.command: set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUND to zone untrust
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.explanation: Configure the application target area for the source NAT ruleset.

parameters.name: rule-set
parameters.explanation: Set of rules names, e.g. OUTBOUND.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.explanation: Target area name, e.g. untrust.

set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] match source-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.command: set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUND rule NAT-INSIDE match source-address 192.168.10.0/24
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.explanation: Configure the source address range that the source NAT rules match.

parameters.name: rule-set
parameters.explanation: Set of rules names, e.g. OUTBOUND.

parameters.name: rule
parameters.explanation: Rule name, such as NAT-INSIDE.

parameters.name: source-address
parameters.explanation: Matches the source address range.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Number of subnet mask bits in the source address range.

set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] then source-nat pool [parameter3]
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.command: set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUND rule NAT-INSIDE then source-nat pool address-group1
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.explanation: Configure the source address conversion behaviour for source NAT rules.

parameters.name: rule-set
parameters.explanation: Set of rules names, e.g. OUTBOUND.

parameters.name: rule
parameters.explanation: Rule name, such as NAT-INSIDE.

parameters.name: pool
parameters.explanation: Name of the address pool used to convert the source address, e.g., address-group1.
